name: autocad-local-bridge
description: Draw, dimension, hatch, annotate, list, move and erase entities in the active local AutoCAD 2027 drawing through validated tools.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to an AutoCAD 2027 plug-in running on the same Windows computer over a token-protected localhost socket. Every tool is narrow and validated; there is no arbitrary command or LISP execution.

tools.name: autocad_status
tools.description: Check whether AutoCAD 2027 is connected and return the active drawing name and its units (units, insunits, lunits, measurement, dimlfac, dimscale). Use this before any drawing action. If units is "unitless", ask the user what one drawing unit means before drawing with a unit.

tools.name: draw_line
tools.description: Draw exactly one straight line in the active AutoCAD drawing. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: draw_rectangle
tools.description: Draw exactly one axis-aligned closed rectangle in the active AutoCAD drawing. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: draw_polyline
tools.description: Draw one 2D polyline through the given points in the active drawing. Set closed to true to join the last point back to the first (needs at least 3 points). Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: add_linear_dimension
tools.description: Add one linear (rotated) dimension measuring the distance between two points, using the current DIMSTYLE. rotation 0 measures horizontally, 90 vertically. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: add_aligned_dimension
tools.description: Add one aligned dimension parallel to the line between two points, using the current DIMSTYLE. offset is the signed distance of the dimension line from that line (positive = left side when walking from point 1 to point 2). Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: add_angular_dimension
tools.description: Add one angular dimension between two non-parallel lines, using the current DIMSTYLE. The arc point picks which of the angles is dimensioned. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: add_hatch
tools.description: Fill one closed polygon with a non-associative hatch. pattern defaults to SOLID; any predefined AutoCAD pattern name such as ANSI31 can be used. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: add_text
tools.description: Add one multiline text (MText) object to the active drawing. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: add_leader
tools.description: Add one multileader: an arrow at the arrow point, a leader line to the landing point, and text at the landing. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: List model-space entities with handle, type, layer, bounding box and key geometry (line endpoints, polyline vertices, dimension measurement and override text, text content, block name, position, rotation and attributes). Read-only. Set `units` to get lengths back in that unit (e.g. the unit the user is working in); without it values are in drawing units. The result's `units` field says which.

tools.name: erase_entities
tools.description: Erase exactly the model-space entities with the given handles. Reports handles that were not found. Never acts on a selection or on anything not listed. Undo with UNDO in AutoCAD.

tools.name: delete_layer
tools.description: Erase every entity on one layer (model and paper space) and then purge the layer. Refuses layer 0, Defpoints, the current layer, locked layers, and layers still used by block definitions. Confirm with the user before calling.

tools.name: move_entities
tools.description: Move exactly the model-space entities with the given handles by dx, dy. Reports handles that were not found. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: set_dimension_props
tools.description: Change the appearance of one existing dimension. Provide at least one property. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: zoom_extents
tools.description: Zoom the active model-space view to the drawing extents. Does not change the drawing.

tools.name: draw_circle
tools.description: Draw one circle, e.g. a round table, column or fixture detail. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: draw_arc
tools.description: Draw one circular arc running counter-clockwise from startAngle to endAngle (degrees, 0 = +X). For door swings in walls prefer draw_walls openings. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: draw_walls
tools.description: Draw double-line walls along a centreline path with one thickness and mitred corners. Use closed: true for the exterior outline. Doors, windows and plain openings are placed by segment index (0 = from points[0] to points[1]) and offset from that segment's start to the opening's near edge along the centreline. Doors and openings break the wall lines and get jamb caps and a centreline room separation line (layer A-ROOM-SEP); doors also get a leaf and 90 degree swing (hinge: start/end of the opening, swing: left/right of the path direction). Windows keep the wall lines and add jamb and glazing lines. End interior walls at the face of the wall they meet (half the other wall's thickness from its centreline). Run detect_rooms with wallLayers [wall layer, A-ROOM-SEP]. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: place_furniture
tools.description: Place one furniture or fixture symbol as a block (CB_<KIND>) centred at x, y. Width runs along the symbol's X, depth along Y, and the back edge (bed headboard, sofa back, WC tank) faces +Y at rotation 0. To put the back against a wall: wall above = 0, wall on the left = 90, wall below = 180, wall on the right = -90; place the centre half the depth away from the wall face. Fixtures go on A-FIXT, furniture on A-FURN unless layer is given. Omit width/depth for standard sizes. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: draw_band_part
tools.description: Draw one ceiling band part (chandelier ring, frame, lit band) as a production drawing: plan with face letters, edge and thickness dimensions, radius notes, title and developed length, plus one elevation per face (equal faces grouped), with an optional LED light strip. points are the outer sharp corners of a convex outline. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: insert_block
tools.description: Insert one block reference by name: a block already defined in the drawing, or <name>.dwg from the bridge block library folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%\AutoCADClaudeBridge\blocks). Scales are ratios and are not unit-converted. attributes sets attribute values by tag. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: copy_entities
tools.description: Copy the entities with the given handles by dx, dy, count times (copy n is offset n times dx, dy), e.g. a row of chairs. Returns the new handles. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: rotate_entities
tools.description: Rotate the entities with the given handles about a base point by an angle in degrees (counter-clockwise). Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: mirror_entities
tools.description: Mirror the entities with the given handles about the line through (x1, y1) and (x2, y2). keepOriginal (default true) makes mirrored copies; false flips the originals. Text is mirrored as geometry, so mirror text separately or re-add it. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: floor_plan_summary
tools.description: Summarize the floor plan in the active drawing: saved plan type, model-space extents with width and height, and entity counts by layer, by type, and by block name (furniture, fixtures, doors). Read-only. Call this first to understand a floor plan before listing entities. Set `units` to get lengths back in that unit.

tools.name: query_region
tools.description: List model-space entities inside a rectangular region of the floor plan, tested by bounding box. mode "crossing" (default) returns entities whose bounding box overlaps the region; "inside" returns only those whose bounding box lies fully within it. Read-only. Same entity format as list_entities. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: set_floor_plan_type
tools.description: Save the floor plan type in the active drawing so later sessions know what kind of plan it is. Stored inside the DWG; undo with UNDO in AutoCAD. Ask the user if the type is unclear.

tools.name: detect_rooms
tools.description: Find the rooms of the floor plan as the closed areas formed by walls on the given layers. Doorway gaps up to maxOpeningWidth are closed along the wall line, tiny gaps up to maxDraftingGap are closed in any direction, and remaining open wall ends are flagged. Each room returns net area (holes such as columns removed), area in square metres, perimeter, outline, the text labels and room-tag attributes inside it (its name when there is exactly one), and the blocks inside it. Read-only. Use floor_plan_summary first to find the wall layers. Defaults are 1.2 m, 2 cm, 0.5 m and 1 m²; unitless drawings need them passed explicitly. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: save_rooms
tools.description: Run detect_rooms with the same arguments and save every room in the drawing (Named Objects Dictionary entry CLAUDE_BRIDGE_ROOMS) with an ID, name, status, outline, net and gross area, perimeter, source wall handles with geometry fingerprints, and timestamps. Rooms matching saved ones (by unique label name, then by outline overlap) keep their IDs; saved rooms no longer found are removed. Rooms with several labels are saved with status needs_review. confirmRoomIds marks rooms confirmed only after the user checked them; it is refused for needs_review rooms or when the plan has open wall ends, and then nothing is saved. Undo with UNDO in AutoCAD. Pass the user's numbers exactly as stated with `units` set to the unit they used (e.g. 300 cm -> 300 with units "cm"). Never convert units yourself. If the user gave no unit, ask them.

tools.name: get_rooms
tools.description: Return the rooms saved in the drawing by save_rooms. Each room is checked against the drawing: if any of its source walls was erased, moved, reshaped or put on another layer, its status is stale with the reasons; run save_rooms again to update it. Statuses: ok, needs_review, confirmed, stale. Only confirmed rooms have been checked by the user. Read-only. Set `units` to get lengths and areas back in that unit; square metres are always included.

tools.name: export_room_schedule
tools.description: Write the saved rooms as a CSV room schedule: room ID, name, status, net and gross area in m², perimeter in m, and warnings. Rooms are checked for staleness first; needs_review and stale rooms keep that status in the file and are never shown as confirmed. Writes to path, or next to the saved DWG as <drawing>-rooms.csv. Refuses to replace an existing file unless overwrite is true; ask the user first. The file is not undone by UNDO.
